basic_details.job_title: IISER TVM Graduate Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: A one-year apprenticeship with a stipend of Rs. 16,150 per month is on offer at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER TVM, MoE, Govt. of India) for 4 Graduate Apprentice Trainee positions in Library and Information Science, for 2026-27. The essential qualification is MLISc. (Master's Degree in Library Science) with 60% marks. Applications are invited through the web portal nats.education.gov.in, and the last date is 25 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice asks candidates to apply through the web portal https://nats.education.gov.in for the Graduate Apprentice Trainee position in Library and Information Science. The last date is 25-11-2026. The notice names no other steps, fee or documents.

content_sections.heading: IISER TVM Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Thiruvananthapuram (IISER TVM)
Graduate Apprentice Trainee (Subject/Trade: Library and Information Science)
Online, through the web portal https://nats.education.gov.in

content_sections.heading: About IISER TVM
content_sections.text: IISER Thiruvananthapuram is an institute under the Ministry of Education (MoE), Government of India. In this notice it invites applications for apprentice training under the Apprentices Act 1961 and the Apprenticeship (Amendment) rules 2019 (as amended from time to time).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential educational qualification for the Graduate Apprentice Trainee position in Library and Information Science is MLISc. (Master's Degree in Library Science) with 60% marks with sound knowledge of basic IT tools.. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Age limit as on 01.11.2026: UR - 28 Years OBC - 31 Years SC/ ST - 33 Years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship is for a period of 01 year for 2026-27. The notice states that IISER TVM will pay only its share of the stipend. The Government share of the stipend will be credited directly to the trainee's bank account.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER TVM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to apply through the web portal https://nats.education.gov.in for the Graduate Apprentice Trainee position in Library and Information Science. The last date is 25-11-2026. The notice names no other steps, fee or documents.
